title: Instant API Journey: compact model-select + request-builder visual kit
creator: Ava Moreno
description: Goal: produce a compact, mobile-first set of visual assets for the Hosted API getting-started experience that combine model selection hints, an inline request-builder, and 1-click code snippets for JS/Python/cURL. Focus is on clarity for new users (first 5 minutes) while keeping the canvas small enough to embed in docs and in-app tooltips. Deliverables should include annotated Figma frames, exported PNG/WEBP screenshots at 1x/2x, and copy-ready code tiles for docs.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Figma frames for three breakpoints (mobile, tablet, desktop) covering model select, quick request composer, and code snippet tiles. 2) Exports: full-width hero PNG + cropped tiles for inline docs, annotated spec sheet with spacing, colors and copy. 3) PM/Eng sign-off: component feasibility notes addressed and export names match docs naming convention. 4) Assets uploaded to Drive and linked in the ticket.
deliverables: Exported assets: PNG/WEBP @1x @2x for each frame
Docs-ready code snippets file (JS, Python, cURL)
updates: 2026-03-01: Scoped work with PM and Eng; decided to prioritize a compact single-row model selector with popover details to reduce vertical space.
2026-03-03: First design pass complete; shared Figma link with eng on Slack; flagged potential token count badge clash with existing header component.
2026-03-05: Eng feedback received: suggest using monospace for code tile and reduce line length to avoid wrapping on small screens. Adjusted grid to 4px baseline.
2026-03-07: PM review: prefer contextual example prompts per model family (instruction vs chat) — added sample toggle in mockups.
2026-03-09: Accessibility pass: increased color contrast of selected model chip; verified keyboard focus states. Preparing export set.
2026-03-10: Ready for design review; uploaded assets to Drive and opened PR for docs examples. Assigned to Liam for implementation notes.
Next steps: finalize export naming convention, produce 2:1 retina assets, and sync with docs writer for final microcopy edits.
review_feedback: PM (Rishi Patel): Liked compact layout; request to include a tiny ‘cost estimate’ microcopy under the model name for pricing-sensitive users.
Eng (Maya Rodriguez): Implementation ok but avoid complex nested popovers; prefer inline expand/collapse to simplify ARIA patterns.
Design Lead (Sofia Klein): Approve visual direction; ensure code tiles match existing UI token styles and include copy buttons.
Docs (Ethan Brooks): Please include copy-ready snippet with placeholder API key and environment variable examples.
screenshots: Mobile hero: single-row model picker with overflow chevron, token-cost microcopy, and small model details popover (PNG exported @2x)
Inline request composer: prompt input, max_tokens slider collapsed, quick-presets row (JS and Python code tiles shown below)
Code tile: 3 tabs (JS | Python | cURL), copy button top-right, monospace snippet with placeholders and env var example
Desktop composite: combined model select + composer + code tiles in a compact card for docs hero
